arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Data for Jan-Mar 1940 (in thousands of dollars)
months = [1, 2, 3]  # January, February, March

# Individual and Corporation collections (in thousands)
individual = [20561, 43443, 356076]
corporation = [25128, 27503, 298548]

# Calculate ratios (individual/corporation)
ratios = [individual[i] / corporation[i] for i in range(3)]

print("Month | Individual | Corporation | Ratio")
print("------|------------|-------------|--------")
for i, m in enumerate(months):
    print(f"{m:5} | {individual[i]:10} | {corporation[i]:11} | {ratios[i]:.6f}")

# Linear regression: x = month, y = ratio
# Using least squares formula: slope = Σ((xi - x̄)(yi - ȳ)) / Σ((xi - x̄)²)

n = len(months)
x_mean = sum(months) / n
y_mean = sum(ratios) / n

print(f"\nx̄ = {x_mean}")
print(f"ȳ = {y_mean}")

# Calculate slope
numerator = sum((months[i] - x_mean) * (ratios[i] - y_mean) for i in range(n))
denominator = sum((months[i] - x_mean) ** 2 for i in range(n))
slope = numerator / denominator

print(f"\nNumerator: {numerator}")
print(f"Denominator: {denominator}")
print(f"\nSlope: {slope}")
print(f"Slope rounded to thousandths: {round(slope, 3)}")
EOF
